day-84-act-01.title: Synthesis Review: Evidence Kinds, Pre-Registration, and Baseline Discipline
day-84-act-01.objective: Retrieve from memory the block's core distinctions — deterministic fixture evidence versus blocked live evidence, pre-registration versus post-hoc storytelling, and outcome metrics versus tool-behavior metrics — before touching any notes.
day-84-act-01.instructions:
1. Retrieval practice: from memory, write the four metric families, the six contract task ids, and the difference between evidence_kind deterministic and live.
2. Check your recall against live_eval_contract.json; log every miss for the catch-up plan.
3. Summarize the blocked-awaiting-authorization status in one paragraph: what exists (deterministic runs, contract, validator) and what does not (any live measurement).
4. Explain why baseline discipline — freezing the suite, baseline, and hypotheses first — is the block's central habit.
day-84-act-01.exercise_prompt: Write recall_log.md listing the four metric families, all six task ids, and the deterministic-versus-live evidence rule — produced from memory, then self-graded against the contract.
day-84-act-01.hint: If you cannot name a task id or metric family from memory, that gap goes on the spaced-review list.
day-84-act-01.answer: recall = {'metrics':['outcome_passed','tool_behavior_passed','budget_passed','failure_handling_passed'],'tasks':6,'rule':'deterministic fixture evidence != live model evidence; live_value stays null until authorized'}
day-84-act-01.mastery_criterion: Accurately reproduce the block's core concepts from memory and honestly log the gaps.

day-84-act-02.title: Metric Recomputation Drill: From Raw Traces to Checkable Numbers
day-84-act-02.objective: Recompute every contract metric from raw recorded artifacts — the fixture report, the action/observation trace, and the counters — demonstrating that each number is independently checkable.
day-84-act-02.instructions:
1. Re-run the deterministic baseline command and hash the produced report.txt; compare it to expected_report_sha256 in the contract.
2. Walk the action/observation trace: verify every action name is in allowed_tools and every arguments payload is a JSON object.
3. Recompute budget compliance from the recorded step and retry counters against the declared ceilings.
4. Verify failure-handling: every failed observation carries a structured error value and the termination_reason is honest.
5. Record recomputation notes showing input artifact, check performed, and result for each metric.
day-84-act-02.exercise_prompt: Produce recomputation_notes.md mapping each of the four metrics to its source artifact, the check you performed, and the recomputed value.
day-84-act-02.hint: Your notes must let another person reproduce the same numbers without watching you work.
day-84-act-02.mastery_criterion: Recompute all four metrics from raw artifacts and show the evidence chain for each number.

day-84-act-03.title: Four-Language Scientific Evaluation Report Assembly
day-84-act-03.objective: Assemble the block's four-language evaluation report covering protocol, baseline recomputation, confounders, failure taxonomy, cost accounting, and declared non-claims.
day-84-act-03.instructions:
1. Gather the artifacts: eval_protocol.md, baseline_ledger.json, confounder_register.md, failure_taxonomy.json, cost_ledger.csv, and memo.md.
2. Fill the four-language report template (English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese) with identical numbers and identical claims in every edition.
3. Verify terminology parity across editions: pre-registration, baseline, confounder, failure attribution, termination honesty, and evidence kind translate consistently.
4. Confirm the report states blocked-awaiting-authorization and null live values identically in all four languages; no edition may quietly upgrade the evidence.
day-84-act-03.exercise_prompt: Publish the four-language scientific evaluation report; verify each edition carries the same metrics, the same null live values, and the same non-claims.
day-84-act-03.hint: Translate the numbers first; if any edition reports a different count, fix the edition not the number.
day-84-act-03.mastery_criterion: Deliver a four-language report with verified metric parity and no edition overstating the evidence.

day-84-act-04.title: Consolidation & Assessment Review: Agent Evaluation Mastery Check and Catch-Up Plan
day-84-act-04.objective: Complete the block consolidation: pass the mastery check, convert every logged gap into a spaced-review item, and certify the learning evidence is honest and complete.
day-84-act-04.instructions:
1. Take the Independent Mastery Check covering: pre-registration discipline, the four metric families, evidence kinds, confounder control, failure attribution, and null live values.
2. For every missed item, create a spaced-review entry naming the concept, the artifact to restudy, and the planned review day.
3. Verify the mastery check result, the self-marked completion, and the observed test evidence are recorded separately — self-report never stands in for observed results.
4. Certify the evidence bundle: protocol, ledgers, memo, and report all reference actual artifacts and carry the blocked-awaiting-authorization status honestly.
day-84-act-04.exercise_prompt: Submit mastery_check_record.json containing the check outcome, the per-gap spaced-review list, and a certification that every reported number traces to a recomputed artifact.
day-84-act-04.hint: A gap you write down is a review item; a gap you hide becomes next week's failure.
day-84-act-04.mastery_criterion: Close the block with an honest mastery record: gaps logged, reviews scheduled, evidence certified.
